name: Council upholds removal of fire chief, adds road repair money
summary: At its Oct. 8 meeting, the council approved more funding for road patching, discussed changes to city vehicle use and a formal interview process for department heads, and voted to uphold the mayor's removal of the fire chief. The fire department reported 116 calls in September.

name: Hanceville budget projects $5.46 million in revenue
summary: The city's budget for October 2026 through September 2027 projects about $5.46 million in revenue and $5.17 million in spending.

name: City looks at fuel costs and take home vehicles
summary: Because of rising fuel prices, the council discussed no longer letting department heads and on call staff take city vehicles home.

name: ALDOT grant money goes to drainage and sidewalks
summary: The council approved an agreement with ALDOT so about $20,000 in remaining grant funds can be used for drainage and sidewalk improvements. The same meeting approved a tax abatement for ZincFast and street closures for the Mud Creek festival.

name: Holly Market vendors wanted
summary: Parks and Recreation is looking for craft, gift and food vendors, plus a Santa and carriage ride providers, for the December Holly Market.

name: Knapsacks for Kids asks for support
summary: The weekend food program packed 3,800 bags for Hanceville students last school year and now accepts Cash App donations.

name: Council meeting records posted
summary: The City of Hanceville posts records for each council meeting on its news page, most recently for the Oct. 8 meeting.
